voiceover: Did you know Claude Code sends 33k tokens before even reading your prompt? That’s a huge overhead... Understanding token overhead can save you costs and improve efficiency when using AI models in production. Claude Code uses around 33,000 tokens, while OpenCode only needs about 7,000. That’s 4.8 times heavier! OpenCode's caching is way more efficient, which means lower costs for you. If you’re working in production, these costs can skyrocket if you don’t track your usage. A great way to manage this is by using a logging proxy to capture your requests and see exactly how many tokens you’re using. So, be aware of token overhead... It can really help you save money while working with AI.
